name: 45-Degree Back Extension
description: Set hips on 45-degree bench. Lower torso, then raise by extending hips and squeezing glutes.

name: 90/90 Hip Switch
description: Sit in 90/90 hip position and rotate knees side to side with control.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
description: Kneel with ab wheel under shoulders. Roll forward while bracing, then pull back to start.

name: Adductor Rock Back
description: Start on hands and knees with one leg extended to side. Rock hips back and forward slowly.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization
description: Kneel with one foot forward and drive knee over toes while heel stays down.

name: Archer Push Up
description: Use a wide hand position. Shift weight toward one arm as the opposite arm stays straighter, then alternate.

name: Arm Circles
description: Extend arms and make controlled circles forward and backward to warm shoulders.

name: Arnold Press
description: Start with dumbbells at shoulder level, palms facing you. Rotate wrists outward while pressing overhead. Reverse motion on descent.

name: Assisted Pull Up
description: Use an assisted pull-up machine or band. Pull chest toward bar, then lower with control.

name: Back Extension
description: Anchor hips in back extension bench. Lower torso, then extend hips to raise body in line.

name: Back Squat (High Bar)
description: Place bar high on traps. Squat down with upright torso, then drive through feet to stand.

name: Back Squat (Low Bar)
description: Place bar lower across rear delts. Sit hips back and down, then drive up through midfoot.

name: Band External Rotation
description: Anchor a band at elbow height. Rotate forearm outward while keeping elbow at the side.

name: Band Pull-Apart
description: Hold band at shoulder height. Pull band apart until hands move out to sides, then return slowly.

name: Band Shoulder Dislocates
description: Hold a band wide and move arms from front to overhead and behind, then return.

name: Banded Clamshell
description: Lie on side with knees bent and band above knees. Open top knee, pause, then lower.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
description: Place resistance band around legs. Step sideways with controlled tension, keeping knees slightly bent.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
description: Lie on floor with bar over hips. Drive hips upward, squeeze glutes, then lower to floor.

name: Barbell Shrug
description: Hold bar in front of thighs. Elevate shoulders straight up, pause, then lower.

name: Battle Ropes
description: Hold rope ends and create waves, slams, or alternating pulses while bracing core.

name: Bear Crawl
description: Move forward on hands and feet with knees close to floor. Keep hips low and core braced.

name: Belt Squat
description: Attach belt to loading point. Squat while torso stays upright, then stand through midfoot.

name: Bench Dip
description: Place hands on a bench behind hips. Lower by bending elbows, then press back up.

name: Bench Press (Barbell)
description: Lie on bench with feet flat. Lower bar to chest with control, press up explosively. Keep core tight and shoulder blades retracted.

name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
description: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells at chest level. Press up until arms are extended, then lower with control.

name: Bench Press (Smith Machine)
description: Lie under a Smith machine bar. Unrack, lower bar to mid-chest, then press upward while keeping shoulder blades set.

name: Bent Over Row (Barbell)
description: Hinge at hips, back straight. Pull bar to lower chest/upper abdomen, squeeze shoulder blades. Lower with control.

name: Bicep Curl (Barbell/Dumbbell)
description: Stand holding weights at sides. Curl weights to shoulders, squeeze biceps at top. Lower with control, avoid swinging.

name: Bicycle Crunch
description: Lie on back and alternate bringing elbow toward opposite knee while extending other leg.

name: Bird Dog
description: Start on all fours. Extend opposite arm and leg, pause, then return and alternate.

name: Box Jump
description: Stand facing a box. Jump onto it with soft landing, step down, and repeat.

name: Box Squat
description: Squat back to a box or bench, lightly pause, then drive up to standing.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Rear foot elevated on bench. Lower front leg until thigh parallel, drive through front heel to stand. Unilateral movement.

name: Burpee
description: Drop to floor, kick feet back, perform push-up if desired, jump feet in, and stand or jump.

name: Butterfly Stretch
description: Sit with soles of feet together. Let knees fall outward and gently hinge forward.

name: Cable Crunch
description: Kneel facing high cable with rope. Crunch ribs toward pelvis, then return with control.

name: Cable Curl
description: Stand facing low cable. Curl handle or bar toward shoulders while keeping elbows near sides.

name: Cable External Rotation
description: Stand beside a cable with elbow bent at 90 degrees. Rotate forearm outward while keeping elbow tucked.

name: Cable Fly
description: Stand between cable handles. Sweep arms together in a wide arc while keeping a soft elbow bend.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
description: Attach ankle strap to low cable. Kick leg backward while keeping torso stable, then return.

name: Cable Hip Abduction
description: Attach ankle strap to low cable. Move leg out to side, pause, then return with control.

name: Cable Hip Adduction
description: Attach ankle strap to low cable. Sweep leg inward across body, then return slowly.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
description: Stand beside a low cable. Raise handle out to side to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
description: Face away from high cable with rope overhead. Extend elbows forward/up, then bend with control.

name: Cable Pull Through
description: Face away from low cable holding rope between legs. Hinge back, then drive hips forward.

name: Cable Pullover
description: Use a high cable or rope. Sweep arms down and back without bending elbows much.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
description: Set cables at shoulder height. Pull handles outward and back with soft elbows.

name: Cable Tricep Kickback
description: Set cable low. Hinge forward and extend elbow backward against cable resistance.

name: Cable Woodchop
description: Set cable high or low. Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally across body, then return slowly.

name: Calf Raise
description: Stand on balls of feet, raise heels as high as possible. Lower slowly to full stretch. Can use bodyweight or added weight.

name: Calf Wall Stretch
description: Place hands on wall, step one foot back, keep heel down, and lean forward.

name: Captain Chair Knee Raise
description: Support body on captain chair pads. Raise knees toward chest, then lower with control.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
description: On hands and knees, alternate arching and rounding the spine slowly.

name: Chest-Supported Row (Dumbbell)
description: Lie chest-down on an incline bench. Row dumbbells toward ribs, squeeze shoulder blades, and lower.

name: Child's Pose
description: Kneel and sit hips back toward heels while reaching arms forward and relaxing torso.

name: Chin Up (Supinated)
description: Underhand grip, hands shoulder-width. Pull up emphasizing biceps and lats. Lower with control to full arm extension.

name: Clean and Press
description: Clean weight to shoulders, then press overhead and return with control.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
description: Grip bar slightly narrower than shoulder width. Lower to lower chest and press up, emphasizing triceps.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
description: Use close or neutral grip handle. Pull toward upper chest, squeeze lats, then return with control.

name: Cobra Stretch
description: Lie face-down, place hands under shoulders, and gently lift chest to extend spine.

name: Commando Pull Up
description: Grip bar with hands facing each other on opposite sides. Pull head to one side of bar, alternating sides.

name: Concentration Curl
description: Sit with elbow braced against inner thigh. Curl dumbbell up, then lower slowly.

name: Cossack Squat
description: Wide stance, shift weight to one side while keeping other leg straight. Lower into deep squat, return to center, alternate sides.

name: Couch Stretch
description: Place back foot on wall or bench in kneeling lunge. Tuck pelvis and hold quad/hip flexor stretch.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
description: Pull one arm across chest with opposite arm until rear shoulder stretches.

name: Crunch
description: Lie on back with knees bent. Curl shoulders off floor using abs, then lower slowly.

name: Cuban Press
description: Raise elbows high, externally rotate shoulders, then press lightly overhead and reverse.

name: Curtsy Lunge
description: Step one leg diagonally behind the other. Lower into a lunge, then return to standing.

name: Dead Bug
description: Lie on back with arms and knees up. Extend opposite arm and leg while keeping lower back down.

name: Dead Hang
description: Hang from pull-up bar with arms straight. Keep shoulders active and hold for time.

name: Deadlift (Conventional)
description: Stand with feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot. Hinge at hips, grip bar, drive through heels to stand. Keep bar close to body.

name: Decline Bench Press (Barbell)
description: Lie on a decline bench. Lower bar to lower chest and press up, keeping shoulders retracted.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
description: Lie on a decline bench with dumbbells. Press from lower chest line to above chest, then lower under control.

name: Decline Push Up
description: Place feet on a bench and hands on floor. Lower chest, then press up while keeping body straight.

name: Deep Squat Hold
description: Sit into a deep squat, keep heels down if possible, and gently open hips with elbows.

name: Deficit Reverse Lunge
description: Stand on a small platform. Step backward into a deeper lunge, then drive up through front leg.

name: Diamond Push Up
description: Form diamond shape with hands under chest. Lower until chest touches hands, focus on tricep engagement. Push up explosively.

name: Dip
description: Support body on parallel bars. Lower by bending elbows until shoulders below elbows, then press up. Lean forward to target chest more.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
description: Hinge forward with load across hips. Raise heels high, pause, then lower into stretch.

name: Donkey Kick
description: Start on all fours. Drive one heel upward by extending hip, squeeze glute, then lower.

name: Doorway Pec Stretch
description: Place forearm on doorway and step through gently until chest stretches.

name: Downward Dog
description: Press hips upward from plank-like position, pushing chest toward thighs and heels toward floor.

name: Dragon Flag
description: Lie on bench holding behind head. Raise body into a straight line and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Fly
description: Lie on bench with dumbbells extended above chest. Lower weights in wide arc until chest stretch, then squeeze chest to bring weights together.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
description: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell over chest. Lower weight behind head, then pull back over chest.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
description: Hold dumbbells in front of thighs. Hinge back until hamstrings stretch, then drive hips forward.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
description: Hold dumbbells at sides. Shrug shoulders upward, pause briefly, then lower fully.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
description: Hold dumbbell at one side. Bend sideways slightly, then pull torso back upright.

name: Dumbbell Snatch
description: Lift dumbbell from floor to overhead in one explosive motion, then lower and switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Squat
description: Hold dumbbells at sides or shoulders. Squat down with control and stand back up.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
description: Hold dumbbells at shoulders. Squat down, then stand and press overhead in one motion.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
description: Hinge forward with upper arm beside torso. Extend elbow backward, then lower slowly.

name: Elliptical
description: Use elliptical with smooth leg drive and optional handle push-pull rhythm.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
description: Hold EZ-bar with underhand grip. Curl toward shoulders, then lower under control.

name: Face Pull
description: Stand facing cable machine at face height. Pull rope to face level, external rotate shoulders. Targets rear delts and rotator cuff.

name: Farmer's Walk
description: Carry heavy weights at sides, walk forward maintaining upright posture. Targets grip, core, and traps.

name: Figure Four Stretch
description: Lie on back, cross one ankle over opposite knee, and pull legs toward chest.

name: Fire Hydrant
description: Start on all fours. Lift bent knee out to side, pause, then lower while keeping hips stable.

name: Floor Press (Barbell)
description: Lie on floor under a barbell. Lower until upper arms touch the floor, then press up.

name: Floor Press (Dumbbell)
description: Lie on floor with dumbbells. Lower elbows until upper arms touch floor, then press up.

name: Flutter Kicks
description: Lie on back with legs straight. Alternate small up-and-down kicks while keeping lower back down.

name: Foam Roller Calf Mobilization
description: Sit with foam roller under calf and roll slowly from ankle toward knee.

name: Foam Roller Lat Mobilization
description: Lie on side with foam roller under lat and slowly roll tender areas.

name: Foam Roller Quad Mobilization
description: Lie face-down with foam roller under thigh and roll slowly from hip to knee.

name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
description: Place foam roller under upper back and gently extend over it in small segments.

name: Forearm Plank
description: Hold body in a straight line on forearms and toes. Brace abs and avoid sagging hips.

name: Forward Lunge
description: Step forward into a lunge, lower until both knees bend, then push back to starting position.

name: Frog Pump
description: Lie on back with soles of feet together and knees out. Pump hips upward while squeezing glutes.

name: Frog Stretch
description: Kneel with knees wide and hips back. Hold a gentle inner-thigh stretch.

name: Front Rack Carry
description: Hold kettlebells or dumbbells in front rack at shoulders. Walk while bracing core.

name: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
description: Stand with dumbbells in front of thighs. Raise arms to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Front Raise (Plate)
description: Hold a weight plate with both hands. Raise to shoulder height, then lower with control.

name: Front Squat
description: Bar across front deltoids, elbows high. Squat down keeping torso upright. More quad dominant than back squat.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
description: Secure feet in glute-ham developer. Lower torso and extend back up using hamstrings and glutes.

name: Goblet Carry
description: Hold kettlebell or dumbbell at chest. Walk with ribs down and torso upright.

name: Goblet Squat
description: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest. Squat down between knees, then stand tall.

name: Good Morning
description: Place bar on upper back. Hinge at hips with soft knees, then return by squeezing glutes.

name: Hack Squat
description: Stand on hack squat platform with shoulders under pads. Lower until knees bend deeply, then press up.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Hold dumbbells with neutral grip (palms facing each other). Curl to shoulders, targets brachialis and forearms more than standard curl.

name: Hamstring Curl (Stability Ball)
description: Lie on back with heels on ball. Lift hips and curl ball toward body, then extend legs.

name: Hand-Release Push Up
description: Lower chest to floor, briefly lift hands, then plant hands and push back up.

name: Hang Clean
description: Start with bar above knees. Extend hips explosively and catch bar on shoulders.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
description: Hang from bar, bring knees to chest. Lower with control. Easier variation of hanging leg raise.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Hang from bar, raise straight legs to 90 degrees or higher. Lower with control. Targets lower abs and hip flexors.

name: Happy Baby Pose
description: Lie on back, hold feet or shins, and gently pull knees toward armpits.

name: High Plank
description: Hold top of push-up position with hands under shoulders. Brace core and keep body straight.

name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
description: Set pulleys high. Pull handles down and together toward lower chest to emphasize lower chest.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
description: Sit with pads outside thighs. Push knees outward, pause, then return slowly.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
description: Sit with pads outside knees. Squeeze thighs together, then return slowly.

name: Hip Thrust
description: Upper back against bench, bar across hips. Drive hips up until body forms straight line. Squeeze glutes at top, lower with control.

name: Hollow Body Hold
description: Lie on back with arms and legs extended off floor. Press lower back down and hold.

name: Inchworm Walkout
description: Hinge down, walk hands to plank, then walk feet toward hands or reverse.

name: Incline Bench Press (Barbell)
description: Set bench to an incline. Lower bar to upper chest, then press up while keeping wrists stacked over elbows.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
description: Sit on an incline bench with arms hanging. Curl dumbbells without swinging, then lower fully.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: Set bench to 30-45° incline. Press dumbbells from chest level to full extension above shoulders. Control the eccentric phase.

name: Incline Push Up
description: Place hands on a bench or box. Lower chest toward the surface, then push back up.

name: Incline Treadmill Walk
description: Walk on treadmill at an incline while keeping posture tall and steps controlled.

name: Inverted Row
description: Lie under a fixed bar. Pull chest to bar while keeping body straight, then lower with control.

name: JM Press
description: Lower bar toward upper chest/neck with elbows forward, then extend elbows to press back up.

name: Jump Rope
description: Jump repeatedly over rope with light foot contacts and steady rhythm.

name: Kettlebell Clean
description: Swing kettlebell from hinge and guide it into front rack position, then lower and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
description: Swing kettlebell overhead in one motion, finishing with arm locked out and shoulder stable.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Hinge kettlebell between legs, then snap hips forward to swing it to chest height.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
description: Kneel in lunge position, tuck pelvis slightly, and shift forward until front of hip stretches.

name: L-Sit
description: Support body on parallel bars or floor. Lift legs to form L shape, hold position. Requires strong core and hip flexors.

name: Landmine Press
description: Hold the end of a landmine bar at shoulder height. Press forward and upward, then lower with control.

name: Landmine Row
description: Straddle a landmine bar with row handle. Pull bar toward torso, then lower under control.

name: Landmine Squat
description: Hold landmine bar at chest. Squat down with upright torso, then stand and keep bar close.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: Seated at lat pulldown machine. Pull bar to upper chest, squeeze lats at bottom. Control the eccentric phase fully.

name: Lat Stretch on Bench
description: Kneel facing bench with elbows on bench. Sit hips back until lats stretch.

name: Lateral Lunge
description: Step out to the side, bend the stepping knee, keep other leg straight, then push back to center.

name: Lateral Raise
description: Stand holding dumbbells at sides. Raise arms out to shoulder height with slight bend in elbows. Lower slowly to resist gravity.

name: Lateral Step Up
description: Stand beside a box. Step up sideways through the working leg, then lower with control.

name: Lean-Away Lateral Raise
description: Hold support with one hand and lean away. Raise dumbbell out to side, then lower slowly.

name: Leg Curl (Seated/Lying)
description: Lying or seated in leg curl machine. Curl heels toward glutes against resistance. Lower with control to full extension.

name: Leg Extension
description: Seated in leg extension machine. Extend legs against resistance until knees fully extended. Lower with control.

name: Leg Extension (Single-Leg)
description: Sit in leg extension machine. Extend one leg fully, pause, then lower with control.

name: Leg Press
description: Seated in leg press machine. Lower weight until knees at 90 degrees, then press up explosively. Keep lower back against pad.

name: Leg Swings Front-to-Back
description: Hold support and swing one leg forward and backward with controlled range.

name: Leg Swings Side-to-Side
description: Hold support and swing one leg across body and outward with control.

name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
description: Turn head slightly down toward armpit and gently assist until back of neck stretches.

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
description: Set pulleys low. Sweep handles upward and inward toward upper chest while keeping ribs down.

name: Lying Hamstring Stretch with Strap
description: Lie on back with strap around foot. Raise leg until hamstring stretch is felt and hold.

name: Machine Chest Press
description: Sit with handles at chest height. Press handles forward until arms extend, then return with control.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
description: Sit in hip thrust machine with pad over hips. Drive hips upward, squeeze glutes, then lower.

name: Machine Row
description: Sit at row machine with chest supported. Pull handles toward torso, squeeze shoulder blades, then return.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
description: Sit with handles at shoulder height. Press overhead, pause briefly, then lower under control.

name: Meadows Row
description: Stand beside a landmine bar. Row the bar end toward hip with one arm, then lower.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
description: Raise medicine ball overhead and slam it forcefully to floor, then reset safely.

name: Mountain Climber
description: Start in high plank. Drive knees toward chest alternately while keeping hips stable.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull Up
description: Hang with palms facing each other. Pull body up until chin clears handles, then lower fully.

name: Nordic Curl
description: Kneel with feet secured. Lower body forward with control, resisting with hamstrings. Push back up to starting position.

name: Overhead Carry
description: Hold weight overhead with arm locked out. Walk while keeping ribs down and shoulder stable.

name: Overhead Press
description: Stand with feet shoulder-width. Press bar from shoulder level to overhead. Keep core tight, slight lean back at top. Lower with control.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
description: Stand or sit holding weight overhead. Lower weight behind head by bending elbows, then extend back up.

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
description: Raise one arm overhead, bend elbow, and gently pull elbow back with opposite hand.

name: Pallof Press
description: Stand sideways to cable or band. Press handle straight out while resisting rotation, then return.

name: Pec Deck Fly
description: Sit with elbows or forearms on pads. Bring arms together in front of chest, then open slowly.

name: Pendulum Squat
description: Set shoulders under pads. Lower into deep squat on pendulum machine, then drive up through platform.

name: Pigeon Pose
description: Bring one shin forward on floor and extend other leg back. Fold forward for glute stretch.

name: Pike Push Up
description: Start in downward dog position. Lower head toward ground by bending elbows, then push back up. Targets shoulders and triceps.

name: Pistol Squat
description: Single leg squat. Lower on one leg while extending other leg forward. Descend until thigh parallel, then stand explosively.

name: Plank Shoulder Tap
description: Hold high plank and tap opposite shoulder with one hand while resisting hip rotation.

name: Plate Pinch Hold
description: Pinch weight plates between fingers and thumb. Hold for time while standing tall.

name: Plyometric Push Up
description: Lower into a push-up, then press explosively so hands leave the floor. Land softly and repeat.

name: Power Clean
description: Pull bar explosively from floor and receive it on shoulders in a partial squat.

name: Power Snatch
description: Pull bar from floor to overhead in one motion, receiving in a partial squat.

name: Preacher Curl
description: Rest upper arms on preacher pad. Curl weight up, squeeze biceps, then lower under control.

name: Prone Leg Curl
description: Lie face-down on leg curl machine. Curl heels toward glutes, pause, then lower with control.

name: Pull Up
description: Standard pull-up with neutral or overhand grip. Pull body up until chin clears bar, focus on lat engagement. Lower with control.

name: Pull Up (Overhand)
description: Hang from bar with overhand grip, hands wider than shoulders. Pull body up until chin clears bar. Lower with control.

name: Pull Up (Wide Grip)
description: Wide overhand grip, hands 1.5x shoulder width. Pull up focusing on lats. Lower slowly to maximize time under tension.

name: Push Jerk
description: Dip with knees, drive bar overhead, and receive with arms locked and knees bent.

name: Push Press
description: Hold bar at shoulders. Dip slightly with knees, drive upward, and press bar overhead.

name: Push Up
description: Start in plank position. Lower body until chest nearly touches ground, then push up explosively. Keep body straight from head to heels.

name: Rear Delt Fly (Dumbbell)
description: Hinge forward with dumbbells hanging. Raise arms out to sides, squeeze rear delts, then lower.

name: Reverse Crunch
description: Lie on back with knees bent. Curl hips upward toward ribs, then lower with control.

name: Reverse Curl
description: Hold bar with overhand grip. Curl toward shoulders, emphasizing brachialis and forearms.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
description: Lie face-down on reverse hyper machine. Swing legs upward by extending hips, then lower.

name: Reverse Lunge
description: Step backward into a lunge, lower under control, then drive through front foot to stand.

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
description: Kneel upright. Lean back with control, resisting with quads and hip flexors. Return to upright position.

name: Reverse Pec Deck Fly
description: Sit facing a pec deck machine. Pull handles apart until arms line with shoulders, then return slowly.

name: Reverse Plank
description: Sit with hands behind hips and legs straight. Lift hips until body forms a line and hold.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
description: Rest forearms on bench with palms down. Extend wrists upward, then lower under control.

name: Ring Push Up
description: Hold gymnastics rings or straps in a push-up position. Lower chest between hands, then press up while stabilizing.

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
description: Stand holding bar. Hinge at hips, lower bar along legs until hamstring stretch. Drive hips forward to return to standing.

name: Rowing Machine
description: Drive with legs, swing torso, then pull handle to ribs. Reverse smoothly for each stroke.

name: Russian Twist
description: Sit with torso leaned back. Rotate weight or hands side to side while bracing core.

name: Scapular Pull Up
description: Hang from pull-up bar. Keep arms straight and pull shoulder blades down, then relax under control.

name: Scissor Kicks
description: Lie on back with legs straight. Cross legs over each other in alternating scissor motion.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Seated with feet braced. Pull handle to lower chest/upper abdomen, squeeze shoulder blades together. Return with control.

name: Seated Calf Raise
description: Sit with knees bent and pads on thighs. Raise heels, pause, then lower under control.

name: Seated Chest Press (Cable)
description: Sit between cable handles at chest level. Press forward and together, then return slowly.

name: Seated Figure Four Stretch
description: Sit upright, cross ankle over opposite knee, and hinge forward until glute stretches.

name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
description: Sit with one or both legs extended. Hinge forward from hips until hamstrings stretch.

name: Seated Shoulder Press (Barbell)
description: Sit with bar at upper chest. Press overhead without excessive back arch, then lower with control.

name: Seated Spinal Twist
description: Sit tall, cross one leg, and rotate torso toward bent knee while breathing steadily.

name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
description: Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height. Press overhead, then lower under control.

name: Side Plank
description: Lie on side, support body on one forearm and side of foot. Hold straight line, engage obliques and glute medius.

name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
description: Lie on side, grasp top ankle, and draw heel toward glute for a quad stretch.

name: Single-Arm Cable Row
description: Sit or stand holding one cable handle. Pull elbow back toward ribs, then return with control.

name: Single-Arm Cable Tricep Pushdown
description: Use one cable handle. Extend elbow downward, pause, then return without moving upper arm.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
description: Support one hand and knee on bench. Row dumbbell toward hip, then lower fully.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Press
description: Stand with landmine bar at one shoulder. Press up and forward with one arm while resisting rotation.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
description: Lie on back with one foot planted. Lift hips using one leg, squeeze glute, then lower.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
description: Stand on one leg holding weight. Hinge forward while back leg reaches behind, then return upright.

name: Sissy Squat
description: Keep hips extended while knees travel forward. Lower with control and return by extending knees.

name: Skullcrusher
description: Lie on bench, hold weight overhead. Lower weight toward forehead by bending elbows, then extend explosively.

name: Sled Pull
description: Attach straps to sled and walk backward or forward pulling sled under control.

name: Sled Push
description: Push sled handles forward with strong leg drive and braced torso.

name: Smith Machine Squat
description: Position bar on upper back in Smith machine. Squat down and press up through feet.

name: Soleus Wall Stretch
description: Stand facing wall with back knee bent and heel down. Lean forward to stretch lower calf.

name: Sphinx Stretch
description: Lie face-down on forearms and gently lift chest while hips stay on floor.

name: Spider Curl
description: Lie chest-down on an incline bench. Curl dumbbells or bar upward, then lower fully.

name: Split Squat
description: Stand in split stance. Lower back knee toward floor, then drive through front foot to stand.

name: Squat (Barbell)
description: Bar on upper back, feet shoulder-width. Descend until thighs parallel to floor, knees track over toes. Drive through heels to stand.

name: Squat Jump
description: Lower into a squat, jump upward explosively, land softly, and repeat.

name: Squat Pry
description: Hold deep squat and gently shift side to side or press knees outward with elbows.

name: Stair Climber
description: Step continuously on stair climber while keeping torso tall and controlled foot placement.

name: Standing Cable Chest Press
description: Stand staggered between cable handles. Press handles forward from chest height while bracing core.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Stand with balls of feet on platform. Raise heels high, pause, then lower into stretch.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
description: Stand tall, place one heel forward, hinge at hips, and hold a gentle hamstring stretch.

name: Standing Lat Stretch
description: Hold a rack or post, sit hips back, and lean away until side/back stretches.

name: Standing Leg Curl
description: Use standing leg curl machine. Curl heel toward glute, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
description: Stand on one leg and pull opposite heel toward glute while keeping knees close.

name: Stationary Bike
description: Pedal on stationary bike at chosen resistance while keeping a smooth cadence.

name: Step Up
description: Place one foot on a box or bench. Drive through front foot to stand tall, then step down.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
description: Hold bar with minimal knee bend. Hinge at hips until hamstrings stretch, then stand tall.

name: Stir the Pot
